_comment: Total Respec config. Defaults are vanilla Skyrim race-base values. The Draught of Renewal resets H/M/S/CarryWeight to these values, then triggers vanilla level-ups so you re-allocate (level - 1) attribute points via Skyrim's native H/M/S choice menu.
_skyvalor: If you use SkyValor (sets player base Health to 250 and Stamina+50), edit: baselineHealth: 250, baselineStamina: 150.
_survival_mode: If you have Survival Mode active (Creation Club AE), edit: baselineCarryWeight: 150. Survival Mode halves the player's initial CW from 300 to 150 as a base-value change, so the JSON must match.
